Every tool definition (all feature groups, read-write). query_logs is defined twice (a static definition and a per-dialect one); the static one is kept. With a project_id configured the server removes project_id parameters, not done here.
toolDefinitions.json is generated by the server build and committed; fields that are not part of a tools/list Tool (requiredScopes, skills, surface) are dropped.

Runtime defaults substituted: AWS_API_MCP_SUPPRESS_DEPRECATION_WARNING unset (deprecation notice shown), region us-east-1 (the code fallback), file access mode workdir (the default), working directory /tmp/aws-api-mcp/workdir (a representative Linux default). get_execution_plan is registered only when EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_SCRIPTS is set, so it is not in the default tools/list.
